title: ci: build the hub with Quarto 1.10.19
description:
This PR raises the Quarto version that the daily hub build uses from 1.8.26 to 1.10.19.

Since 21 October every package in the hub has failed at the render step. great-docs' Markdown-pages extension now sets the stage at which its filter runs, which Quarto accepts only from 1.9.18, so Quarto 1.8.26 rejects the extension with a YAML validation error. The workflow still reports success, because it deploys the failed builds.
